faqs.question: What is PAVii.AI?
faqs.answer: PAVii.AI is a blockchain-based security and observability platform for AI agents and LLMs. Pavii checks every agent call, blocks harmful actions and records what each agent does. Buckleson builds Pavii on Hyper 0X, its own post-quantum-resistant blockchain.

faqs.question: How does a blockchain protect my AI agents and data?
faqs.answer: Pavii keeps important rules as smart contracts on Hyper 0X. A smart contract is a program on the blockchain that nobody can quietly change. An egress contract decides what an agent can send and do. Pavii links each receipt to the one before it, so nobody can secretly change or delete a record.

faqs.question: How does Pavii keep personal data private?
faqs.answer: The privacy gate removes personal data and secrets before a model sees the prompt. Pavii also uses zero-knowledge proof (ZKP) designs. A ZKP lets one party prove a fact without showing the data behind it. Model providers can learn from usage, but they do not get data that can harm you.

faqs.question: Which AI agents and models does Pavii support?
faqs.answer: Pavii is one gateway for any AI agent or LLM. It works with Claude, Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Grok, OpenCode and your own custom agents. You can build new agents in Pavii or connect the agents that you use now.

faqs.question: What happens when an agent breaks a rule?
faqs.answer: The kill switch moves the agent from observed to restricted to stopped. Pavii blocks the harmful call, or at least makes it visible to your team. A person can stop any agent at any time.

faqs.question: How does Pavii control access to the company brain?
faqs.answer: The company brain is a shared memory that Pavii builds from usage, as a graph of your products, people and knowledge. Pavii checks each request for access on the blockchain. So the agent of a junior employee cannot read restricted knowledge, even inside the shared brain.

faqs.question: Can I deploy Pavii on my own blockchain?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can use the Pavii chain, run your rules on-chain or deploy your own chain inside your organization. Pavii can also connect to the platforms that you use now. You do not need to change your business logic.

faqs.question: What does agentic observability show my team?
faqs.answer: Agentic observability shows how your agents behave: each call, each tool, each blocked action and the cost. Your team can use this record to find problems and make agents better. Pavii saved more than 100M AI tokens across more than 82K queries.
